morphology.shape: Septate hyphae with conidiophores bearing a flask-shaped vesicle

habitat.hostAssociation: Ubiquitous environmental mold; opportunistic pathogen in immunocompromised hosts
habitat.environmentalOccurrence: Extremely common in soil, decaying vegetation, and indoor/outdoor air — conidia are constantly inhaled
habitat.reservoir: Environmental — soil, compost, decaying plant material

microscopy.stain: Lactophenol cotton blue mount; KOH preparation of tissue or sputum
microscopy.appearance: Septate hyphae with acute-angle (~45°) branching; conidiophores with a flask-shaped vesicle bearing chains of conidia

culture.growthCharacteristics: Rapid growth at 37-45°C — thermotolerance aids pathogenicity
culture.colonyMorphology: Fluffy colonies with a white margin

identificationClues: Septate hyphae with acute-angle branching on tissue/KOH preparation
Conidiophore with a flask-shaped vesicle bearing radiating chains of conidia — the 'aspergillus head'
Rapid growth at 37-45°C on Sabouraud agar
Thermotolerance distinguishes it from many other environmental molds

diseases: Invasive pulmonary aspergillosis — in immunocompromised patients
Aspergilloma — 'fungus ball' in pre-existing lung cavities
virulenceFactors: Small conidia (2-3 µm), easily inhaled into alveoli
Gliotoxin and other secondary metabolites — immunosuppressive
clinicalImportance.transmission: Inhalation of airborne conidia; not transmitted person to person
clinicalImportance.epidemiology: Conidia are ubiquitous in the environment and constantly inhaled by everyone; clinical disease occurs mainly in immunocompromised patients (e.g. neutropenic, transplant, or high-dose steroid patients) or those with pre-existing lung disease
clinicalImportance.labSignificance: Septate, acute-angle-branching hyphae on tissue biopsy plus characteristic culture morphology support the diagnosis; serum galactomannan antigen testing is also used clinically

examFacts.keyBiochemicalReaction: Not identified by biochemical testing — by microscopic and culture morphology
examFacts.importantTest: Lactophenol cotton blue mount showing conidiophore morphology; serum galactomannan
examFacts.distinguishingFeature: Acute-angle branching septate hyphae plus thermotolerant growth at 37-45°C
